lines.en: I push forward half off the ground.
My ki flattens the grass below.
I skim up along the hillside.
Shoulders forward, my pace is quick.
I sweep over the treetops.
Landing, I kick up a ring of dust.
I take the straight line, no detours.
The current drags at my hem.
One step carries me two blocks.
I slide to your flank.
I shift my weight and close in.
I bear down from above.
I hover with my ki circling.
My third eye sits on my brow.
I gather my ki bit by bit.
I watch the shadow on the ground.
I press a hand to my shoulder.
My breathing is heavy as a drum.
I lower my eyes.
I roll my wrist.
I stay silent and wait.
My hem drops and lifts again.
I draw my feet together.
I slowly open my fist.
I am listening to the wind.
I am thinking how to fight this.
I look you straight on.
I stand half a block above you.

lines.zh: 你站那儿不动是等我吗
lines.en: Standing still, waiting for me?
First let me see your level.
Your energy is unsteady.
Tien does not like chatter.
If you want a fight, hurry up.
I lift a hand toward you.
Backing off will not help.
I have your face memorised.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西挡不住我
lines.en: What you hold will not stop me.
I edge a bit closer.
Do not count on me holding back.
I tilt my head at your stance.
Your gap is far too obvious.
Why do you not start?
I hold still until you strike.
I lift my ki slowly.
That broke my ki.
I am pressed back half a block.
Blood drips from my chin.
I drag in a harsh breath.
My arm goes numb.
I brace against my knee.
That one came down hard.
My collar has split.
I gather my ki again.
I have not lost.

lines.zh: 你拿这东西想换点什么
lines.en: What would you trade that for?
That will not work on me.
I brush it aside.
Do not reach so close.
I glance at it once.
I have no taste for such tricks.
Keep it for yourself.
Three eyes on you.
I turn away from it.
My ki is enough already.
You hit my aura and bounce off.
I drive forward once.
You are pushed back two blocks.
I raise an elbow to block.
We brush past each other.
The knock flips my hem.
I drop my feet and stop.
Ramming me is useless.
I turn to shed the force.

lines.zh: 你从我的气流里穿过去
lines.en: You pass through my current.
She floats above me.
Our ki joins into one.
She reaches down and pulls me up.
We dive side by side.
She blocks the wind at my side.
We draw our ki in at once.
She is steadier than I.
We lower our eyes to the ground.
I do as she says.
We need few words.
I scoop it up from midair.
I pinch a flying fragment.
Ki floats it to my hand.
I catch the falling tile.
I throw it aside.
I pick up a handful of soil.
I open my hand and drop it.
I close it in my palm.
I do not even look.
I fling it to the ground.
I bring my ki to full.
You moved first.
I have the angle.
The soil starts to tremble.
I raise my palm.
You cannot run now.
I have no patience left to wait.
Ki balls at my hand.
You are in a bad spot.
This time I go first.
I lower my body.
I have you inside my reach.

lines.zh: 三只眼分看你的手和脚。
lines.en: Three eyes split between your hands and your feet.

lines.zh: 一声闷响从我脚下传开
lines.en: A dull boom spreads from my feet.
I press one step in.
Now it is my turn.
I move with your steps.
I know the moment you lift a hand.
I have your jump direction.
I keep one blast ready.
You retreat; I press.
I hold my ki under my palm.
Your breathing has lost its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在你脚边不动。
lines.en: My shadow lies still at your feet from above.
Your guard is thinning.
I will wait one more moment.

lines.zh: 你不进来我就等你进来
lines.en: If you will not come, I wait.
I count your movements.
This shot must land.
You are open when you turn.
I turn my wrist slowly.
The light has gathered enough.
I hold back the urge to strike.
I close half a block more.
I thrust out a ki blast.

lines.zh: 气光贴着他的手臂炸开
lines.en: The blast bursts along his arm.
My kick goes to his flank.

lines.zh: 他挡下一掌，第二掌没挡住
lines.en: He stops one palm, not the next.
I fight at close range.
My knee meets his chest.
I bring an elbow down.
The beam passes his guard.
He slides back two steps.
I chase and add a kick.
I used only two tenths there.
He rolls before standing.
I drive him into a tree.
I pull my palm back; ki still smokes.
His weapon leaves his hand.
I drop in front of him.
I drop straight down from the air.
My landing sinks the ground half a block.
My third eye flashes.
I plant myself before looking up.
Ki blasts the dust off me.
I come down in this clearing.
The wind stops for a moment.

lines.zh: 落地时土从袍角飞起来。
lines.en: Dirt flies off my robe hem as I land.
Someone is waiting for me.
I rise slowly.
A ring of cracks marks the ground.
I appear out of the tree shadows.
I do not hide my ki.

lines.zh: 三只眼，多出来的那只也在看你。
lines.en: Three eyes—the extra one watches too.
You finally came.

lines.zh: 我半浮着冲过来，草被气压倒。
lines.en: I charge half-floating, ki flattening the grass.
I push my ki to its peak.
The place goes quiet.
Fire coils around my forearm.
I tumble out of the air.

lines.zh: 水压着我的胸口，三只眼也睁不开。
lines.en: Water presses my chest; even my third eye cannot open.
The blast throws me several paces.
An arrow pins my side.
Magic locks my wrist.
Hunger keeps my ki from gathering.
Lightning pours down on me.
There is no ground left.
